summary: Elemental Royalty Corp. filed a Form 6-K (via material change report) announcing a regular quarterly dividend of US$0.03 per share (annualized US$0.12) payable on July 15, 2026 to holders of record June 30, 2026. The filing also describes a dividend reinvestment-like alternative for registered shareholders to receive Tether Gold tokens instead of cash. This is a routine dividend declaration with a non-cash election option; it does not involve any M&A, restructuring, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special situation. The dividend is discretionary, ongoing, and part of ordinary capital allocation. No special-situation category applies.
